challenge.method: Compare literal CRLF, literal lone CR, an LF by itself, and reference text for a CR. Read the later attribute-value normalization rule for the order of handling a character reference.
challenge.results: The external input runs through line normalization before parsing. A literal CRLF and a lone CR yield one LF each. The syntax of a CR character reference contains no literal CR, and the attribute processing clauses append the later referenced character.

limitations: The proposition covers the input treatment for external parsed entities. It does not specify the outcome of later attribute processing.
